data.title: Grimes to Make Feature Film Debut in Fully AI-Generated Movie, Lending Her Likeness and Real Voice (Exclusive)
data.description: Grimes is set to make her film debut in AI-generated movie ‘Gods Don’t Give Gifts,’ lending her likeness to the film as an aristocrat character called Zayinth Alda; the sci-fi anthology will become the first fully AI-generated film released in theaters on Dec. 4.
